# Pagination

**Class:** `UltraCanvasPagination` · **Group:** [Navigation and data views](../Groups/Navigation-and-data-views.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasPagination.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasPagination.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasPagination.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Page selector

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasPagination](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasPagination.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPagination> CreatePagination( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, int pageCount = 1, int currentPage = 1);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPagination> CreatePaginationForItems( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, int totalItems, int pageSize, int currentPage = 1);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasPagination(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasPagination(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasPagination(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetInfoFormatter()` | `void SetInfoFormatter(std::function<std::string(int, int, int, int)> fn)` | Takes a callback. |
| `onPageChanged` | `std::function<void(int)> onPageChanged` | fired with the new (1-based) page |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `PaginationMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Numbered` | « ‹ 1 … 4 \[5\] 6 … 20 › » (full page-number strip) |
| `Compact` | ‹ Page 5 of 20 › (prev / info / next) |
| `Simple` | ‹ Prev Next › (prev / next only) |
